$Comment: The wide bar panel, for values that move while a player is out in the world with no ledger
for them to sit beside. Which panel a row lands on is decided by the mod reporting the
movement, so a value only appears here if that mod put it here.
Placement names the spot the panel sits at, one of the files under
Server/ZiggfreedCommon/HudBarPlacements/. Two are shipped for this panel: BottomLeft, three
columns wide above the hotbar, growing upward as rows come up and leaving a band clear for your
own health and mana bars; and TopRight, six columns wide above the quest tracker, growing
leftward as columns open. The spot's file carries the corner, the offsets, how the rows spread
there, the band and the least height. To nudge it without changing the spot, add a Position
block here with only the leaves you want different, or a Columns, RowsPerColumn, Gap or
MinHeight leaf; anything you leave out keeps the spot's own value. A player may pick another
offered spot for themselves in the HUD settings.
MaxVisible is unstated, so every slot the spot's columns can hold is available. RepaintMs is
how often the panel redraws at most: a movement redraws immediately when the last redraw is
already that old, and one arriving sooner is drawn at the window's end. LabelKey names the
panel in the HUD settings.
To change a leaf without copying this file, add an entry keyed 'Grid' to
mods/ziggfreedcommon/hud-bar-panels.json with only the leaves you want different, or use the
Server tab of the HUD settings, which writes that file for you. Set Enabled to false there to
switch this whole panel off for everyone.
